The '''Hydian Spur''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that was the final segment of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]]. It was charted in [[3694 BBY]] by [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] and [[Banu Hydia]].<ref name="TEA" />
